comments.comment: Very clear explanation Saleem sb. Are water boring permissions granted right away after transfer?

Great coverage. Sector 70-D is currently yielding the highest capital appreciation in Phase 1.

Commercial plots on 150ft road allow Ground + 4 floors as per standard MDA bylaws, expandable with compounding fees.

comments.comment: Are files in Sector 80 computerised or manual paper receipts?
All files we handle are 100% computerized with MDA barcode confirmation and biometric eligibility.

videos.title: NADRA Biometric Verification & File Transfer Process Demystified
videos.description: Zubair Ahmed Khan from Karachi Modern Realty guides you through the exact legal steps required to verify your Scheme 45 allotment file, clear NDC dues, and undergo biometric transfer at MDA Headquarters.

comments.comment: Crucial information. Every buyer must ensure biometric verification before releasing the final pay order.
Very helpful brother. How many days does the official transfer letter take after biometric?
Normal processing is 15-20 working days. Fast-track urgent verification takes approximately 7 days.
